definitions.name: begin_verification
definitions.description: Starts verification through the restricted verification service (secure link preferred). The response is generic for zero, one or many matches and never reveals whether an account exists.

definitions.name: commit_appointment_change
definitions.description: Commits a prepared appointment change by action id and digest after the trusted confirmation step. Success is reported only from a COMMITTED receipt.

definitions.name: create_support_request
definitions.description: Creates an internal support request with a support reference pending synchronization (never a Case number). Linked to the account only for an authenticated caller who asks.

definitions.name: get_appointment_options
definitions.description: Lists the authorized subject's upcoming appointments and open administrative times (no clinical matching) from the scheduling system.

definitions.name: get_authorized_case_status
definitions.description: Status of the caller's own (or own organization's) support request by support reference, and a short recap of an open request for an authenticated repeat caller.

definitions.name: get_claim_status
definitions.description: Insurer-reported claim status with its as-of date for the authorized client. Not an eligibility or payment guarantee.

definitions.name: get_invoice_status
definitions.description: Invoice status, balance and line explanation from authoritative billing fields, plus the approved hosted payment path. Never decides coverage, waives fees or promises a refund.

definitions.name: get_login_guidance
definitions.description: Portal sign-in guidance from the approved public corpus. Never resets credentials, never asks for a password, and always directs to the identity provider's own recovery process.

definitions.name: get_provider_onboarding_status
definitions.description: Provider onboarding stage and missing credentialing document types for the provider's own record. Never a credentialing decision.

definitions.name: get_remittance_status
definitions.description: Remittance status for the caller's own or delegating practice only, within a bounded period.

definitions.name: prepare_appointment_change
definitions.description: Prepares a reschedule of the client's own appointment, or a new booking, to an offered open time. Nothing changes until a trusted confirmation and commit.

definitions.name: prepare_billing_review
definitions.description: Prepares a billing review of the client's own open invoice. Nothing is submitted until a trusted confirmation and submit_billing_review. A review never implies a refund.

definitions.name: request_human_transfer
definitions.description: Connects the caller with a person through an allowlisted destination chosen by the gateway. Never requires authentication; the caller cannot choose a number.

definitions.name: request_safety_route
definitions.description: Starts the priority safety handoff to a safety responder. Never requires authentication; stops administrative work; limits, timeouts and budgets never abandon it.

definitions.name: search_approved_runbook
definitions.description: Searches the reviewed public knowledge corpus for an approved answer by public FAQ intent. Returns cited article excerpts with exact versions. Never account-specific.

definitions.name: submit_billing_review
definitions.description: Submits a prepared billing review (action id and digest) after the trusted confirmation step: invoice marked in review, durable review workflow and support request created. Result is REQUEST_ACCEPTED.

definitions.name: submit_complaint
definitions.description: Records a complaint (category only, never free text) into the complaint review workflow with a support reference. Not linked to an account.

definitions.name: submit_partner_intake
definitions.description: Organization-scoped partner intake for the verified partner organization. Never takes or returns an individual's records.
